newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS prices ease on crude weaknesss.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS prices ease on crude weaknesss.

text.p: U.S. crude futures prices continued weakening in ACCESS trade Monday, following profit-taking late in the day and little interest ahead of the mid-week Christmas holiday.
"We've come off on crude and we're looking for a follow-though," Tuesday, a broker said.
NYMEX crude fell 29 cents to $24.79 a barrel in the floor session.
On ACCESS, January crude oil added another nine cents to its losses to trade $24.70 a barrel amid trade of 663 contracts. About 814 contracts traded overall.
January heating oil shed 0.32 cent a gallon to 70.65 cents amid light volume of 46 contracts in January and 88 contracts overall.
Front-month gasoline eased 0.40 cent to 68.50 cents a gallon, as 21 lots traded overall.
